parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) between `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.defaultsToV1WhenNoOverrideOrFlag` and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.nonStringFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` is expected in a test class: each test method exercises a distinct scenario (no override/flag vs. non-string feature flag) and the shared shape reflects common test scaffolding, not accidental duplication. Merging or extracting test methods risks obscuring test intent and coupling distinct failure modes.
